relationships.subject: Sinomenine liposomes
relationships.evidence_quote: It was also found to inhibit JAK2/STAT3 pathway activation by reducing p-JAK2/p-STAT3 expression

key_findings: Sinomenine liposomes (SIN@Lip-HA) alleviated SNI neuropathic pain in rats, shifting astrocytes from A1 to A2 markers.
Effect was associated with JAK2/STAT3 inhibition, reduced TNF-alpha/IL-1beta/IL-6 and enhanced by gabapentin.
